title: Expose custom Dock-menu commands elsewhere

statement.en: Make every custom Dock-menu command available through another visible part of the Mac app.
statement.ja: すべてのcustom Dock menu commandをMacアプリ内の別の見える場所からも利用可能にする。

conditions: Offer the same commands in places such as menu-bar menus or the app interface.
Account for people who don’t use the Dock menu.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Dock menus experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるDock menusの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

title: Prefer high-value custom Dock-menu items

statement.en: Prefer high-value commands and destinations for custom Dock-menu items.
statement.ja: custom Dock menu itemには価値の高いcommandやdestinationを優先する。

conditions: Current or recently open windows can provide convenient navigation destinations.
Limit action shortcuts to a few likely useful choices.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Dock menus experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるDock menusの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

title: Label Dock-menu items succinctly

statement.en: Give every Dock-menu item a succinct label.
statement.ja: すべてのDock menu itemに簡潔なlabelを付ける。

conditions: Apply the general menu-labeling requirement to both system-provided and custom Dock-menu items under app control.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Dock menus experience on the scoped Apple platforms.

title: Consider useful actions for inactive app states

statement.en: Consider listing a few likely useful Dock-menu actions when the app isn’t frontmost or has no open windows.
statement.ja: アプリが前面にない場合やopen windowがない場合は、役立つ可能性が高い少数のDock menu actionを検討する。

conditions: The Mac app isn’t frontmost or has no open windows.
